chunks.title: Inheritance patterns with eye examples
chunks.tldr: AD: every generation, 50% of children, both sexes — NF1, NF2, tuberous sclerosis, VHL, germline RB, Best, some RP, Gardner (FAP CHRPE). Isolated unilateral cases may be new somatic mutations (not transmitted). Many 'AD' tumour syndromes are recessive at the cell level (two hits). AR: one generation, carrier parents → 1 in 4 affected, 2 in 4 carriers; consanguinity — some RP, gyrate atrophy, xeroderma pigmentosum. X-linked recessive: males affected, carrier mothers (half sons affected, half daughters carriers), affected fathers → all daughters carriers, no sons affected — XLRS, ocular albinism, some RP, Norrie, choroideremia. Mitochondrial: mother → all children; fathers never transmit — LHON, Kearns-Sayre. Polygenic/multifactorial: AMD, POAG.
points: Father and son both affected → can't be X-linked or mitochondrial.
chunks.hook: Male-to-male transmission rules out X-linked and mitochondrial.

cards.q: Name three X-linked recessive eye diseases.
cards.a: X-linked retinoschisis, choroideremia, ocular albinism (also Norrie disease, some RP, red-green colour blindness).

cards.q: Can an affected father pass LHON to his children?
cards.a: No — mitochondrial DNA is inherited only from the mother.

chunks.title: Chromosomal syndromes, genetic testing & gene therapy
chunks.tldr: Whole/partial chromosome gain or loss → multiple anomalies, rarely transmitted; karyotype. Trisomy 13 (Patau): microphthalmia, colobomas, cataract. Trisomy 18 (Edwards): hypertelorism, lid anomalies. Trisomy 21 (Down): epicanthus, upslanting fissures, Brushfield spots/iris hypoplasia, keratoconus, cataract. Klinefelter (XXY): epicanthus, hypertelorism. Turner (XO): ptosis, strabismus, cataract (+ colour blindness like males). 13q deletion: retinoblastoma. 11p deletion: aniridia (WAGR). Uses: identify carriers (counselling) and at-risk relatives to target screening (e.g. RB1 carriers → EUAs; non-carriers spared). Prognosis: genotype–phenotype in RP, VHL subtypes (RCC risk), uveal melanoma monosomy 3/GEP class 2. Gene therapy: RPE65 LCA (voretigene), trials in choroideremia, RP, LHON.

cards.a: Microphthalmia, uveal colobomas, congenital cataract (also PHPV, retinal dysplasia).

cards.q: First approved ocular gene therapy and its target?
cards.a: Voretigene neparvovec for biallelic RPE65-associated retinal dystrophy (LCA/RP).
